summary: Become a certified ISO/IEC 27034 Lead Application Security Auditor. Gain essential skills to protect applications and ensure compliance in a digital world.
audienceIntro: This PECB ISO/IEC 27034 Lead Application Security Auditor training is specifically designed for professionals who need to lead and perform application security audits, ensuring compliance and enhancing organizational resilience against evolving threats. This course is designed for: Application Security Auditors seeking to lead and execute ISO/IEC 27034 compliance audits. Information Security Managers overseeing application security governance and risk management. IT Professionals responsible for implementing and maintaining secure application development lifecycles. Consultants advising organizations on application security best practices and compliance. Audit Team Members preparing for ISO/IEC 27034 application security audit engagements. Software Development Managers integrating security into their development and DevOps pipelines. DevSecOps Engineers focused on automating security controls and vulnerability assessments. Risk Managers evaluating application-specific threats and their organizational impact. Compliance Officers ensuring applications meet regulatory and internal security requirements. Quality Assurance Professionals validating application security testing and control effectiveness.
modules: Introduction to Application Security and ISO/IEC 27034
Initiating and Preparing an Application Security Audit
Reporting, Completing, and Following-Up on the Audit
prerequisites: Participants who attend this course must be familiar with application security concepts and have in-depth knowledge of application security principles.
